SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   C. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

3. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   D. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   B. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   C. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   B. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   D. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   D. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

12. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   B. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   D. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Esteem Assessment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
